correctness.rationale: For a friendship graph of m>=1 triangles with one hub and Q=D^-1 A-I, hub-vs-average and antisymmetric blade modes decay as e^(-3t/2), while blade-mean differences decay as e^(-t/2). The exact hub-relative heat values follow by solving this linear ODE. The graph coarea/layer-cake identity reduces arbitrary signed inputs to binary superlevel cuts; complementing excludes the hub and the triangle disjoint-support decomposition has additive input edge variations. Each triangle cuts either one vertex or both; the full peripheral-pair ratio exceeds singleton by ((m-1)/m)(e^(-t/2)-e^(-3t/2)), giving exact N_m(t)=2(m-1)/m e^(-t/2)-(m-2)/m e^(-3t/2), attained by a pair cut. Differentiation gives strict contraction through m=4, unique transient peak for m>=5, and limiting sharp unattained (4/3)sqrt(2/3). Own direct matrix expm and exhaustive hub-free cuts m=1..6 at three positive times match formula within 1e-10; all-size proof is analytic.
